module.name: RTT Tic-Tac-Toe Bot
module.summary: Triadic unit-test bot: perfect-information, tiny state space, visible projection-loss and continuity.

module.name: RTT Tic-Tac-Toe
module.summary: Triadic interpretation of a 3x3 game tree: conformance, projection-loss, and continuity in miniature.
module.purpose: Serve as the unit test for the TriadicFrameworks bots suite, proving the RTT pipeline on a tiny, fully enumerable game.
module.audience: Framework authors, engine integrators, test harnesses

steps: Lumen: extract shape, lines, forks, immediate wins/losses
Hephaestus: classify moves as 1/3 local, 2/3 structural, 3/3 continuity
Aurion: compute ancestry of lines (win paths, draw paths, collapse paths)
Harmonia: synthesize triadic score per move and per position
StateEmitter: emit JSON state conforming to module_tic_tac_toe_schema.json

integration_surface.mode: pure RTT evaluation (no external game engine)

examples.description: Classic X-fork position where a seemingly neutral move causes projection-loss and inevitable collapse.

context.drift: Conformance-first; tiny state space used to validate RTT invariants.
context.coherence: All bots must behave like tic_tac_toe in miniature: clear pipeline, clear schema, clear golden example.
